description: Submit an uploaded file for editing. Two modes: editing_mode="ai" (default) does AI podcast editing of an audio file, billed against credits/subscription minutes (audio only, up to 60 min). editing_mode="human" routes to a professional human editor for audio OR video, billed at standard per-minute rates (credits first, then the default card on file is charged for the remainder); use this for white-label/human-only accounts and for video. Requires order_id and s3_key from barevalue_upload.

editing_mode.description: Who edits: "ai" (default, AI audio editing, credit/minute billed) or "human" (professional human editor, audio or video, card-charged).

express.description: Human audio only: express turnaround for an extra $0.50/min. Ignored for AI and for video.

guest_names.description: Optional names of guests (max 10) for speaker identification in transcript

host_names.description: Optional names of hosts (max 5) for speaker identification in transcript

order_type.description: Media type. Defaults to "audio". "video" is only valid with editing_mode="human".

special_instructions.description: Optional custom instructions for the AI editor (max 2000 chars). Examples: "Remove all mentions of our sponsor", "Keep the blooper at the end"

name: barevalue_submit
